name: IHH Healthcare Berhad
overview: 今年集团完成两家子公司的自愿清算：Suzhou Industrial Park Yuan Hui Health Consulting Co., Ltd. 于8月完成注销，Parkway Life Malaysia Sdn Bhd 于4月启动成员自愿清盘。其余公告主要为诉讼、委员会人事变动、股东大会及派息事项，未披露新增业务、产能扩张或重大合约。
overview_en: During the year, the group completed the voluntary liquidation of two subsidiaries: Suzhou Industrial Park Yuan Hui Health Consulting Co., Ltd. was de-registered in August, and Parkway Life Malaysia Sdn Bhd commenced member's voluntary winding up in April. Other announcements mainly covered litigation, committee changes, general meetings and dividend matters, with no disclosure of new businesses, capacity expansion or major contracts.

segments.name: 其他服务
segments.note: 今年完成一家中国咨询子公司的自愿清算，并启动一家马来西亚子公司的成员自愿清盘。
segments.note_en: The segment completed the voluntary liquidation of a China consulting subsidiary and commenced member's voluntary winding up of a Malaysia subsidiary this year.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: Suzhou Industrial Park Yuan Hui Health Consulting Co., Ltd. 清算完成，于2026年8月7日注销。
actions.text_en: Liquidation of Suzhou Industrial Park Yuan Hui Health Consulting Co., Ltd. was completed and the company was de-registered effective 7 August 2026.

actions.text_en: Commenced voluntary liquidation of Suzhou Industrial Park Yuan Hui Health Consulting Co., Ltd.

actions.text: 启动 Parkway Life Malaysia Sdn Bhd 的成员自愿清盘。
actions.text_en: Commenced member's voluntary winding up of Parkway Life Malaysia Sdn Bhd.
